data.name: Suppressive Fire
data.description: Your well-timed ranged attacks protect your allies as they advance on the battlefield. Whenever you damage a target using a ranged attack, that target can't make attacks of opportunity for 1 round against your allies who also have this feat when they move out of one of the target's threatened squares.
prerequisites: PRETEXT:Far Shot, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, keen senses racial trait.
